utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still catching up, but I heard the repair drive moved to Sunday at the community center. Tell me what you need from me, and I’ll help if I can.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — that’s right, Sunday at the community center. I’m still keeping an eye on the supply list, so just let me know what we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just send me the time and place for the repair drive, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I still need the time and place, and then I can keep track of what we’re short on for the supply list.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I’m still piecing the details together, but I’ll let you know exactly what we need as soon as I’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: No worries — just keep me posted when you’ve got the list, and I can help out.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I think it’s still going okay, but I may have missed the latest changes.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Could you start with the broken chairs and any loose shelves? That would help a lot for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m still double-checking the repair drive details, and once I’ve got them I’ll let you know exactly what help we need.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Mina — it’s moved to Sunday at the community center. Once you’ve got the final list, send it my way and I’ll keep track of it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Just a reminder, Mara — the repair drive is on Sunday at the community center now. If you hear any urgent requests, send them my way and I’ll add them to the list.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Rosa — I’m still double-checking the repair drive details, and once I’ve got them I’ll send over any urgent needs right away.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — before we start, could you tell me exactly what needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, are we still sorting out the latest details for the repair drive? Tell me what’s needed and I’ll see what I can confirm.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, still checking the boxes and the drop-off spot today. I’ll let you know once I confirm everything so we can sort the timing.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Bo — I’m still catching up, so just send me the confirmed time and drop-off spot when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Tess — I’ll spread the word that it’s Sunday at the community center and pass along any urgent repair requests I hear.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll keep an ear out for broken chairs and loose shelves, and send anything urgent your way.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Sam — could you help cover setup and the check-in table? I’m juggling school pickups, so that would really help.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can bring over my tools for the repair drive. Just tell me what you need fixed first.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. Let’s start with the loose front gate and the porch step if you’ve got time.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m still double-checking the repair drive details, Eli—once I’ve got them, I’ll let you know exactly what help we need.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Uli. Just let me know the plan when it’s set, and I’ll help where I can.
